subthemes.name: Testing What AI Can Actually See and Understand
subthemes.gist: Papers build benchmarks to test whether vision-language models can handle real images, spatial reasoning, and visual understanding tasks that humans find natural — from design aesthetics to ancient pottery.

subthemes.name: Making Sure AI Reasons Correctly Step by Step
subthemes.gist: Papers evaluate whether language models actually think through problems logically, trace their reasoning faithfully, and catch when they make mistakes — rather than just guessing the right answer.

subthemes.name: Building Better Benchmarks for New Capabilities
subthemes.gist: Papers design and construct new evaluation datasets for emerging abilities like agents solving real problems, code generation, scientific discovery, and handling specialized domains that weren't tested before.

subthemes.name: Checking How Well Models Handle Multimodal Content
subthemes.gist: Papers develop tests for how models work with mixed inputs like text plus images, videos, audio, tables, and graphs — ensuring they can coordinate information across different types of data.

subthemes.name: Detecting When Models Are Wrong or Biased
subthemes.gist: Papers measure model uncertainty, robustness to tricky inputs, and hidden biases — catching cases where models confidently give wrong answers or fail on edge cases.

subthemes.name: Making Testing Fair and Scientifically Sound
subthemes.gist: Papers improve how benchmarks are scored and designed so results are reproducible, reliable, and reveal genuine progress rather than just progress on specific test data.

subthemes.name: Compressing and Reusing Data Efficiently
subthemes.gist: Papers figure out how to build smaller datasets that still teach models the important things, or how to turn larger datasets into more useful versions without losing information.

subthemes.name: Testing Specialized Reasoning and Knowledge
subthemes.gist: Papers create benchmarks for narrow domains like medical diagnosis, chemistry, law, theorem proving, or biological science — where background knowledge and careful reasoning both matter.

subthemes.name: Evaluating Agents and Reinforcement Learning in Real Settings
subthemes.gist: Papers test AI agents trying to solve actual problems like cybersecurity, power systems, travel planning, or video game strategy — measuring whether they can act in complex real-world scenarios.

subthemes.name: Checking If Models Understand Across Languages and Time
subthemes.gist: Papers test whether models work in multiple languages, understand time-series patterns, handle long conversations, and maintain knowledge across different contexts and sequences.
